4.title: Worst Song Ever #4 - Cheese in Grandpa's Car
4.lyrics:
WORST SONG EVER #4

“Oops, I Did a Song”

[Intro]
One, two, three, four—
Wait.
Was I supposed to start on four?

...Four.

[Verse 1]
I woke up late at the crack of noon,
Ate a bowl of cereal with a spoon.
Put on my left shoe, then my right,
That's how shoes work.
I'm doing all right.

Saw a bird.
It was a bird.
That's probably the best line you've heard.

[Pre-Chorus]
Here it comes!
The part that's good!

...Nope.

[Chorus]
BEEP BOP, FLIP-FLOP,
CHICKEN IN A ZIPLOC!
WIGGLE WIGGLE, PICKLE PICKLE,
SOMEBODY CALL MY MOM!

Hey!

BEEP BOP, FLIP-FLOP,
DON'T KNOW WHEN THIS SONG STOPS!
NA-NA-NA, BLAH-BLAH-BLAH—
WHO PUT CHEESE IN GRANDPA'S CAR?!

[Post-Chorus]
Cheese.
Cheese.
Automotive cheese.

(unnecessarily dramatic)
CHEEEEEEEEESE!

[Verse 2]
I fell in love at the DMV,
She was number 82, I was 83.
I said, "Girl, are you renewing your plates?"
She said, "Sir, please sit down and wait."

Romance.

Then I bought a burrito.
This has nothing to do with the story.

[Pre-Chorus]
Can we skip the chorus?

NO.

[Chorus]
BEEP BOP, FLIP-FLOP,
CHICKEN IN A ZIPLOC!
WIGGLE WIGGLE, PICKLE PICKLE,
SOMEBODY CALL MY MOM!

Hey!

BEEP BOP, FLIP-FLOP,
GRANDMA DOES A BELLY FLOP!
NA-NA-NA, BLAH-BLAH-BLAH—
WHO PUT CHEESE IN GRANDPA'S CAR?!

[Bridge — way too serious]
Sometimes life is like a highway...
Sometimes love is like the rain...
Sometimes we're searching for a reason...

(whispered)
...and sometimes you're just lactose intolerant.

[Beat Drop]

CHEESE!

[Random Rap]
Got a sock in my pocket,
Got a pocket in my sock,
Got a clock that doesn't tick
'Cause apparently it's a rock.

Rock-clock.
Sock-rock.
TikTok—

Wait, can we say TikTok?

Whatever.

I got noodles in my hoodie,
Got a raisin in my shoe,
If you're waiting for the meaning—
Buddy, WE ARE TOO.

[Key Change Nobody Asked For]

BEEEEEP BOP!
FLIIIIIP-FLOP!

[Choir]
🎵 Chicken in a Ziiiiiplooooooc! 🎵

[Final Chorus — irresponsibly huge]

BEEP BOP! FLIP-FLOP!
CHICKEN IN A ZIPLOC!
WIGGLE WIGGLE! PICKLE PICKLE!
GRANDMA, MAKE THE MUSIC STOP!

BEEP BOP! FLIP-FLOP!
SOMEBODY LOST A CROCK-POT!
NA-NA-NA! BLAH-BLAH-BLAH!
STILL GOT CHEESE IN GRANDPA'S CAR!

[Outro]

Why was there cheese in the car?

(long silence)

Grandpa?

...

BEEP BOP.

5.title: Worst Song Ever #5 - My Left Shoe Knows Too Much
5.lyrics:
WORST SONG EVER #5

“My Left Shoe Knows Too Much”

[Intro]
One, two—
Wait, was I supposed to count?
Three... mayonnaise.

[Verse 1]
My left shoe knows too much,
My right shoe lost its touch,
I put my socks inside the fridge
And now they taste like lunch.

I bought a tiny trampoline,
To bounce a tangerine,
It hit the ceiling, joined a band,
And now it's seventeen.

[Pre-Chorus]
Ooooooh—
I don't know where this song is going.
Ooooooh—
Neither does the guy who wrote it.

[Chorus]
MY LEFT SHOE KNOWS TOO MUCH!
(Too much!)
It knows about the chicken and the truck!
(What truck?!)
I don't know,
That's why this sucks—

🎵 Ba-da-ba-da-BEEEEEEP! 🎵

This is the worst song ever,
Number five!
Somehow we're still alive!
Put your hands in the air
If you don't know why—

LEFT SHOE!
RIGHT SHOE!
CHICKEN!
PIE!

[Verse 2]
I microwaved a paper plate
At quarter after eight,
I asked it how its weekend was,
It said, “I'm running late.”

My neighbor owns a garden hose
That everybody knows,
It majored in accounting
But it dreams of being clothes.

[Pre-Chorus]
Ooooooh—
Here comes the emotional part.
Ooooooh—
Never mind. I have a Pop-Tart.

[Chorus]
MY LEFT SHOE KNOWS TOO MUCH!
(Too much!)
It knows about the chicken and the truck!
(Still what truck?!)
I don't know,
That's why this sucks—

🎵 Ba-da-ba-da-BEEEEEEP! 🎵

This is the worst song ever,
Number five!
Against all odds, it survived!
Tell your friends,
Tell your mom,
Tell a random guy—

LEFT SHOE!
RIGHT SHOE!
CHICKEN!
PIE!

[Bridge — unnecessarily emotional]
Someday...
When I'm old and gray...
I'll look back upon this moment...

And wonder why...

Why...

WHY DID THE TANGERINE JOIN A BAND?!

[Massive Beat Drop]
🍊 BECAUSE IT HAD THE JUICE! 🍊

[Final Chorus — way too epic]
MY LEFT SHOE KNOWS TOO MUCH!
Raise it to the sky and hold it up!
We had a dream,
We had a truck,
We had absolutely no idea
What any of this was!

This is the worst song ever,
NUMBER FIVE!
We shouldn't have made it—
BUT HERE WE ARE TONIGHT!

LEFT SHOE!
RIGHT SHOE!
CHICKEN!
PIE!

Everybody!

LEFT SHOE!
RIGHT SHOE!
CHICKEN!
PIE!

[Outro — whispered]
...the right shoe knows too.

(dramatic gasp)

To be continued.

6.title: Worst Song Ever #6 - Microwave Lobster
6.lyrics:
WORST SONG EVER #6

“Microwave Lobster”

[Intro — unnecessarily dramatic]
I had twelve dollars,
A coupon,
And absolutely no adult supervision.

[Verse 1]
Bought a lobster at the grocery store,
Named him Kevin by the automatic door.
Buckled him up in the passenger seat,
Said, “Kev, tonight we're gonna EAT.”

He looked at me.
I looked at him.
Things got weird around 6:10.

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't own a pot.
I don't own a pan.
But I do own a microwave
And a terrible plan.

[CHORUS]
MICROWAVE LOBSTER!
BEEP-BEEP-BEEP!
I pushed “popcorn,”
Then I heard him speak—

“BROOOOOOOOO!”

MICROWAVE LOBSTER!
WHAT HAVE I DONE?!
Kevin kicked the door open
And started to RUN!

He's got butter on his elbows,
Vengeance in his eyes—
MICROWAVE LOBSTER
HAS COME FOR MY LIFE!

[Verse 2]
Kevin stole my Honda around quarter to eight,
Blew through a stop sign doing thirty-eight.
Cop said, “Sir, was that lobster driving your car?”

I said,
“Technically, officer...
it's our car.”

Kevin hit the freeway,
Turned up the bass,
Little rubber bands still hanging off his face.

[Pre-Chorus 2]
He called my mother.
He emptied my bank.
Left one Yelp review:

“Alan's cooking stank.”

[CHORUS]
MICROWAVE LOBSTER!
BEEP-BEEP-BEEP!
Now he's got my password,
My house, and my Jeep!

MICROWAVE LOBSTER!
KING OF THE SEA!
He changed my Netflix profile
From “Alan” to “KEVIIIIIN!”

[Bridge — tender piano for absolutely no reason]
Kevin...
If you're listening...

I'm sorry.

I should've boiled you.

[silence]

Actually, that sounded worse.

[massive key change]

[FINAL CHORUS]
MICROWAVE LOBSTER!
CLAW-CLAW-CLAW!
HE'S RUNNING FOR MAYOR
AND HE'S ABOVE THE LAW!

MICROWAVE LOBSTER!
THE CROWD GOES WILD!
HE'S GOT A LITTLE BRIEFCASE
AND A LINKEDIN PROFILE!

I lost my car!
I lost my home!
Kevin bought a condo
And a cellular phone!

MICRO—WAVE—LOBBBBBSTERRRR!

[Outro — children's choir]
♪ Never press popcorn...
When cooking crustaceans... ♪

[Kevin, whispered]
Beep.

7.title: Worst Song Ever #7 - Emergency Pants
7.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I woke up late on a Tuesday night,
Put my left shoe on my right.
Ate cold beans with a plastic fork,
Then drove three miles just to stare at pork.

My phone said, “Sir, your storage is full.”
My horoscope said, “Avoid the bull.”
I sneezed so hard that I changed my plans—
Thank goodness I packed my emergency pants.

[Pre-Chorus]
Nobody asked.
Nobody knew.
Nobody needed
Verse number two.

[Chorus]
EMERGENCY PANTS!
Emergency pants!
When life gets weird, you take your chance!
When destiny slips and circumstance cracks—
You reach in the trunk for your backup slacks!

Worst Song Ever #7!
We have officially lowered the bar!
EMERGENCY PANTS!
EMERGENCY PANTS!
They don't match my shirt—
BUT HERE WE ARE!

[Verse 2]
I bought a candle that smelled like ham,
Named it Kevin. I don't know why I am
The kind of man who'd spend nine bucks
On meat-scented wax beside rubber ducks.

Then Kevin fell.
Kevin rolled.
Kevin disappeared beneath the stove.
I whispered, “Brother, this isn't goodbye.”
Then forgot about Kevin until July.

[Bridge – unnecessarily emotional]
Someday...
When I'm old...
And the winds of time
Have blown cold...

I'll open my trunk
And there they'll stand—
Wrinkled polyester,
Waistband in hand.

My emergency pants.

[ABSURD KEY CHANGE]

EMERGENCY PAAAAANTS!
THE TROUSERS OF CHAAAAANCE!
When your zipper gives up
In the middle of France!

When your nachos attack!
When you sit in a pie!
When a goose steals your belt
And refuses to say why!

[Final Chorus]
EMERGENCY PANTS!
Emergency pants!
The anthem nobody requested to dance!
Worst Song Ever #7—
We're seven songs deep!
And somehow this garbage
Has learned how to KEEP!

EMERGENCY PANTS!
EMERGENCY PANTS!

[Music abruptly stops]

...Kevin?

[one lonely kazoo note]

8.title: Worst Song Ever #8 - My Left Sock Has a Podcast
8.lyrics:
Worst Song Ever #8 - “My Left Sock Has a Podcast”

[Verse 1]
My left sock started a podcast,
At a quarter after three,
He interviewed a toaster
About emotional debris.
The toaster got defensive,
Said, “I’m more than making bread!”
Then my microwave applauded,
And the refrigerator fled.

[Pre-Chorus]
I said, “Nobody asked for this.”
My lamp said, “Let him cook.”
Now the blender has a Patreon,
And my spatula wrote a book.

[Chorus]
🎵 Worst Song Ever #8! 🎵
We’re peaking way too late!
My left sock has a podcast,
And my right one does debate!
The dishwasher’s an influencer,
My couch is selling fate—
I tried to turn the music off,
BUT THE MUSIC SAID, “TOO LATE!”

[Verse 2]
My ceiling fan got verified,
Though nobody knows why,
It posts motivational quotes
Like, “Spin your dreams and fly.”
My Roomba joined a boy band,
But it only knows one note,
And somehow my electric bill
Is legally a goat.

[Pre-Chorus]
My shampoo launched a clothing line,
My toothpaste bought a yacht,
The garbage disposal texted me:
“Bro… you up?”
I was not.

[Chorus]
🎵 Worst Song Ever #8! 🎵
We’re peaking way too late!
My left sock has a podcast,
And my right one does debate!
The dishwasher’s an influencer,
My couch is selling fate—
I tried to turn the music off,
BUT THE MUSIC SAID, “TOO LATE!”

[Bridge — unnecessarily emotional]
Sometimes…
When the house gets quiet…
I wonder if the objects really need me.

Then the air fryer whispers:

"Your free trial has expired."

[ABSURD KEY CHANGE]

NOOOOOOOOOOO!

[Final Chorus]
🎵 WORST SONG EVER #8! 🎵
Somebody shut the gate!
The toilet's running for mayor,
And it's polling forty-eight!
My mattress joined a pyramid scheme,
My forks are shipping freight—
And my left sock's podcast episode
IS THREE HOURS AND FORTY-EIGHT!

[Outro]
“Welcome back to Sock Talk.
Today’s sponsor is—”

[CLICK]

…my right sock.

[tiny kazoo solo]

Subscribe.

9.title: Worst Song Ever #9 - Who Put the BEEP in My Burrito
9.lyrics:
:::writing{variant="document" id="58314" title="Worst Song Ever #9 - "I Put My Phone in the Fridge""}

Worst Song Ever #9 - "I Put My Phone in the Fridge"

[Verse 1]
I put my phone in the fridge last night,
Put the orange juice in my shoe.
Tried to charge my grilled cheese sandwich,
Now the toaster has Bluetooth.

I waved goodbye to a parking meter,
Held the door for a cardboard man.
Bought twelve feet of garden hose
'Cause the cashier said, “You can.”

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't know where I'm going,
But I'm making pretty good time.
My elevator doesn't reach the top—
But the basement's looking fine.

[CHORUS]
🎵 WHO PUT THE BEEP IN MY BURRITO?!
WHO PUT THE SOCK IN THE STEW?!
I got seven little problems
And six of 'em are you!

I'M RUNNING WITH SCISSORS—
They're safety scissors, Mom!
Worst Song Ever #9,
AND I STILL CAN'T FIND MY THUMB! 🎵

[Verse 2]
I ordered soup at the hardware store,
Asked the waitress for a drill.
She said, “Sir, this is a Home Depot.”
I said, “Fine. Just bring the bill.”

My neighbor owns a leaf blower,
He named it Theodore James.
Every Tuesday they eat breakfast
And discuss their middle names.

[Pre-Chorus]
My left shoe filed for bankruptcy,
My right one's doing okay.
My belt has started freelancing—
It only works on Thursdays.

[CHORUS]
🎵 WHO PUT THE BEEP IN MY BURRITO?!
WHO PUT THE SOCK IN THE STEW?!
I got seven little problems
And six of 'em are you!

I'M RUNNING WITH SCISSORS—
They're safety scissors, Mom!
Worst Song Ever #9,
AND I STILL CAN'T FIND MY THUMB! 🎵

[Bridge — unnecessarily emotional]
Sometimes...

When the moon is high...

I think about that coupon...

It expired in July.

(tiny piano)

Forty cents...

Gone forever.

[ABSURD KEY CHANGE]

[FINAL CHORUS — WAY TOO BIG]
🎵 WHOOOO PUT THE BEEEEEP IN MY BURRITOOOO?!
WHO PUT MY PANTS IN THE ZOO?!
I GOT SEVENTEEN LASAGNAS
AND A CANOE MADE OF SHAMPOO!

I'M RUNNING WITH SCISSORS!
THEY'RE STILL SAFETY SCISSORS, MOM!
WORST SONG EVER NUMBER NINE—

(music stops)

Wait.

Why is my phone cold?

(refrigerator door opens)

...oh.

[one completely unnecessary final chord]

BONG.
:::

10.title: Worst Song Ever #10 - My Pants Have Wi-Fi
10.lyrics:
[INTRO — whispered like a serious technological breakthrough]

Connected.

Oh no.

My pants have Wi-Fi.

[VERSE 1]

Woke up this morning, put my blue jeans on,
They asked for a password before I could yawn.
My left pocket beeped, my right pocket flashed,
Then both of my kneecaps downloaded an app.

I said, “Pants, we need boundaries.”
They said, “UPDATE REQUIRED.”
I tried to hit “later”—
MY BELT CAUGHT FIRE.

[PRE-CHORUS]

Three bars!
Four bars!
Full signal strength!

My trousers can connect
From an unreasonable length!

[CHORUS]

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
WHY? WHY? WHY?
Streaming little movies
From my upper thigh!

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
Everybody knows!
I got Bluetooth in my belt loops
And a hotspot in my clothes!

Ohhhhhhh—

Worst Song Ever #10,
And we're doing it again!

My pants!
Have!
WIIIIII-FIIIIII!

[VERSE 2]

I walked into Walmart, aisle twenty-three,
My pants paired themselves with a rotisserie.
The chicken said “READY.”
My zipper said “COOL.”
Then somebody's toaster joined my network at school.

My socks got jealous.
My shoes formed a band.
My underwear started
A podcast called PANTS.

I didn't subscribe.

Nobody subscribed.

SEVENTEEN EPISODES DROPPED.

[CHORUS]

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
WHY? WHY? WHY?
They've got better reception
Than the router I buy!

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
The future is here!
My cargo shorts are buffering
Directly in my ear!

My pants!
Have!
WIIIIII-FIIIIII!

[BREAKDOWN — everything suddenly becomes absurdly beautiful]

[Soft piano]

Sometimes...

Technology connects us.

Sometimes...

Technology divides us.

And sometimes...

[long emotional pause]

...your khakis know the weather.

[CHILDREN'S CHOIR]

Seventy-two degrees!

[Lead singer, crying]

Thank you, pants.

[KEY CHANGE — MASSIVE DRUMS]

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
THE SIGNAL'S IN THE SKY!
SATELLITES ARE CALLING
MY LEFT AND RIGHT THIGH!

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
THE WHOLE WORLD'S LOGGED IN!
THE PASSWORD IS—

[entire band stops]

...pants123.

[STADIUM CROWD]

PANTS!

[drums]

PANTS!

[drums]

PANTS!

[drums]

WI-FI!

[FINAL CHORUS — irresponsibly enormous]

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
WHY? WHY? WHY?
I SENT AN EMAIL YESTERDAY
BY SITTING NEARBY!

MY PANTS HAVE WI-FI!
THERE'S NOTHING LEFT TO PROVE!
EVERY TIME I START TO DANCE
THE DOWNLOAD SPEED IMPROVES!

MY PANTS!

HAVE!

WIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII—

[abrupt tiny recorder solo]

—Fi.

[automated voice]

Your free trial has expired.

[END]

11.title: Worst Song Ever #11 - My Left Sock Has a Lawyer
11.lyrics:
[Intro]
Okay.
Before we start,
my attorney has advised me
not to explain this song.

[Verse 1]
I woke up Tuesday, quarter past eight,
My left sock served me papers by the garden gate.
Said, “Years of mistreatment, the dryer was cruel,
And pairing me with sandals was against every rule.”

I said, “Sock, be reasonable, we’ve been through a lot.”
He said, “Tell it to my lawyer.”
His lawyer was a POT.

A stainless-steel saucepan in a pinstripe tie,
With a legal pad, a briefcase, and a googly left eye.

[Pre-Chorus]
The toaster took the witness stand,
The blender yelled, “OBJECTION!”
My pants requested privacy
And entered sock protection.

[Chorus]
🎵 MY LEFT SOCK HAS A LAWYER!
And apparently I’m going to court!
The charges are confusing,
And the trial is unusually short!

Worst Song Ever #11!
We have officially lost control!
My left sock wants the house,
The car,
And HALF MY OTHER SOCK!

(That doesn't even make sense.)

[Verse 2]
The judge was just a ceiling fan,
He spun and yelled, “Proceed!”
The jury was twelve chicken wings
Who couldn't even read.

My sock produced Exhibit A:
A photograph of lint.
The courtroom gasped collectively—
I still don't get the hint.

My lawyer was a waffle,
Not licensed in the state.
He whispered, “Plead insanity.”
I whispered, “You're a plate.”

[Pre-Chorus]
Then somebody played a kazoo,
The courtroom formed a line,
And somehow this became a dance—
At least until nine.

[Chorus]
🎵 MY LEFT SOCK HAS A LAWYER!
And apparently I’m going to court!
He’s suing for emotional damage
And unauthorized ankle support!

Worst Song Ever #11!
This chorus has nowhere to go!
So everybody clap twice—

CLAP! CLAP!

…and whisper:

potato.

[Bridge — unnecessarily emotional]
Ohhhhh, sock…
We used to walk together.

Through carpet…
Through tile…
Through that weird wet spot
by the refrigerator…

Was it water?

Was it juice?

We may never know.

(tiny violin solo)

[Final Chorus — WAY too big]
🎵 MY LEFT SOCK HAS A LAAAAAWYER!
THE SAUCEPAN'S DEMANDING MY SHOOOOOES!
THE CEILING FAN IS SPINNING!
THE CHICKEN WINGS ARE SINGING!
AND THE WAFFLE JUST MADE THE NEWS!

WORST SONG EVER #11!
A musical legal disgrace!
The jury yelled—

“GUILTY!”

I yelled—

“OF WHAT?!”

They yelled—

“WE HAVEN'T DECIDED!”

[Outro]
So I paid my sock eleven bucks,
He dropped the whole affair.

Then I looked down at my right foot…

(silence)

He's got a lawyer too.

NOOOOOOOOOOO—

kazoo

13.title: Worst Song Ever #13 - That Wave Wasn't Mine
13.lyrics:
[Intro — hushed, dramatic]

I saw a hand rise through the crowded room…
So I raised mine.
That was my first mistake.

[Verse 1]

I smiled wide and waved hello,
Like we were friends from long ago.
They stared straight through me, cold as stone—
They’d waved at someone else I didn’t know.

I could’ve stopped; I could’ve turned,
Accepted that my pride got burned.
Instead, I waved with both my hands
Like I was guiding planes to land.

[Pre-Chorus]

One little wave became a scene,
The strangest thing they’d ever seen.
I couldn’t quit—I’d gone too far…
Now everybody thinks I’m in charge!

[Chorus]

That wave wasn’t mine!
That wave wasn’t mine!
I borrowed it by accident
And crossed a social line.

Now the whole room’s waving,
And nobody knows why—
I started an uprising
With a badly timed “Hi!”

Oh-oh-oh—
That wave wasn’t mine!

[Verse 2]

A stranger copied what I did,
Then seven grown adults joined in.
Someone shouted, “Pass it on!”
The room erupted before long.

The mayor climbed upon a chair,
Declared a brand-new holiday there.
A marching band came through the door—
Nobody knows who called them for.

[Pre-Chorus]

The cameras rolled, the banners flew,
A news reporter asked, “Was it you?”
I cleared my throat and took the stand:
“Yes, I’m the founder of the hand.”

[Chorus]

That wave wasn’t mine!
That wave wasn’t mine!
It somehow crossed three county lines
By half past nine.

Now the whole town’s waving,
There are helicopters in the sky—
I started an uprising
With a badly timed “Hi!”

Oh-oh-oh—
That wave wasn’t mine!

[Spoken Interrogation — music drops to finger snaps]

“Sir, did you knowingly initiate the gesture?”

I thought they knew me.

“Did they?”

No.

“Then why did you keep waving?”

…Momentum.

[Brass Breakdown]

Wave to the left!
Wave to the right!
Wave at a stranger
You have never met in your life!

Wave down low!
Wave up high!
Commit to the mistake
And never explain why!

[Bridge — suddenly sincere]

Maybe every lonely soul
Is waiting to be seen.
Maybe one mistaken wave
Can build a human chain.

Or maybe I embarrassed myself
And made the whole thing weird—
Both interpretations
Are equally revered.

[Final Chorus — huge choir]

That wave wasn’t mine!
That wave wasn’t mine!
But now it has a logo
And a slogan and a sign.

Every nation’s waving,
Satellites reply—
We finally achieved world peace
With a badly timed “Hi!”

Worst Song Ever #13—
Raise your hands up to the sky!
I started an uprising
With a badly timed—

[Sudden silence]

…Oh.

They still weren’t waving at me.

[One tiny triangle note]

14.title: Worst Song Ever #14 - One Trip
14.lyrics:
[Intro — spoken, deadly serious]

Seventeen things.
Two hands.
One trip.

[Verse 1]

I left the car with a noble plan,
Every grocery bag in a single hand.
Milk on my wrist, bread under my chin,
A watermelon balanced against my shin.

Keys in my teeth, eggs on my head,
One wrong twitch and the yogurt is dead.
The neighbors whispered, “Make another trip.”
I whispered back, “I’d rather lose a hip.”

[Pre-Chorus]

The handles cut deep, but I didn’t quit—
Common sense said, “Stop.”
I ignored it.

[Chorus]

One trip! One trip!
Dignity slips, but I make one trip!
Lean to the left, let the potato chips rip—
I may lose the groceries,
But I’m making one trip!

One trip! One trip!
My fingers are blue and my shoulder just flipped.
Call me a fool, call an ambulance quick—
But nobody living makes me take two trips!

[Verse 2]

I reached the porch with a gallon of tea,
A sack of potatoes was dragging one knee.
The salsa fell, but I caught it somehow
With a loaf of bread and the edge of my brow.

The door was locked; that complicated things.
I rang the bell with the frozen onion rings.
The dog saw dinner and began his attack—
I saved the roast, but I sacrificed my back.

[Chorus]

One trip! One trip!
Dignity slips, but I make one trip!
Lean to the left, let the potato chips rip—
I may lose the groceries,
But I’m making one trip!

One trip! One trip!
My fingers are blue and my shoulder just flipped.
Call me a fool, call an ambulance quick—
But nobody living makes me take two trips!

[Verse 3 — escalating]

A storm rolled in from the neighborhood west,
Lightning struck near the chicken breast.
The pavement cracked, the streetlights died,
But the ice cream still remained frozen inside.

A news crew landed in a helicopter,
A medic arrived, then a physical doctor.
They said, “Drop the bags—we’ll carry them in!”
I said, “That would count,” with a trembling grin.

[Breakdown — crowd chant]

How many trips?

ONE!

How many hips?

WAS TWO!

What do we risk?

EVERYTHING!

What did we save?

FORTY SECONDS!

[Quiet Bridge]

Someday, when my grandchildren ask,
“Why do you walk like a broken compass?”
I’ll point to the sky with a faraway stare
And tell them of the groceries
I carried in there.

This is Worst Song Ever #14—
A monument to poor decisions.

[False Ending]

I made it.

[Door creaks open]

Wait…

I left the toilet paper in the trunk.

[Massive Final Chorus — marching band erupts]

ONE TRIP! ONE TRIP!
Turn around slowly with a championship limp!
Back down the stairs on a sinking ship—
If it takes me all night,
I’m still making one trip!

ONE TRIP! ONE TRIP!
Every joint in my body has legally quit!
Throw me a brace and an insurance slip—
There are two kinds of people…

And I don’t make two trips!

[Outro — fading victory chant]

One trip!
One trip!
One tr—

[Sound of groceries crashing]

…Still counts.

15.title: Worst Song Ever #15 - J-E-L-L-O
15.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
She caught my eye in second period
Wrote one word and slid it down
I read the note, tried not to smile
She watched me turn three shades of brown

At the game beneath the bleachers
She said, "You hungry? Yes or no?"
I said, "Depends on what you're serving"
She just laughed and whispered low

[Pre-Chorus]
Everybody's got a question
Everybody wants a clue
But there's a whole lot more to language
When it's only me and you

[Chorus]
J-E-L-L-O, Jello!
There she goes again
One little word across the room
And I'm grinning like a fool

J-E-L-L-O, Jello!
Don't ask me what it means
And if she mentions whipped cream
Well, that's a different kind of dream

[Verse 2]
Friday night at the little diner
Her best friend sitting by her side
She said, "I think I'll have some Jello"
And nearly made me choke on Sprite

Her friend said, "What's so funny?"
She said, "Oh, you had to be there"
Then she winked across the table
Like she hadn't got a care

[Pre-Chorus]
We could tell the whole wide world
But where's the fun in that?
Some things sound a whole lot sweeter
When nobody knows the facts

[Chorus]
J-E-L-L-O, Jello!
There she goes again
One little word across the room
And I'm grinning like a fool

J-E-L-L-O, Jello!
Don't ask me what it means
And if she mentions whipped cream
Well, that's a different kind of dream

[Bridge]
Years from now, when we're much older
And somebody brings dessert
She'll look at me across the table
And I'll remember just one word

No explaining, no confession
No translation, no big scene
Just that smile she's always given
When she says, "And whipped cream?"

[Final Chorus]
J-E-L-L-O, Jello!
Still gets me every time
She can say it in a crowded room
And I know what's on her mind

J-E-L-L-O, Jello!
Keep the mystery alive
Some things are better left unspoken
With a little smile on the side

[Outro — spoken, playful]
"Hey, you want some Jello?"

"Right now?"

"Maybe."

"With whipped cream?"

(She laughs.)

"Don't push your luck."

16.title: Worst Song Ever #16 - I'm Sorry, Vending Machine
16.lyrics:
**[Intro — sparse piano, painfully sincere]**

I put in two dollars,
I pressed B-4,
The pretzels leaned forward…
Then stopped before the door.

I whispered, “Take your time, friend.”
Like patience might prevail.
Then somebody behind me said,
“Sir… you’re talking to a sale.”

**[Verse 1]**

I know it has no feelings,
I know it has no soul,
I know its only purpose
Is exchanging snacks for toll.

But something in that humming
Sounded tired, maybe blue,
So I put my hand against the glass
And said, “I’ve been there too.”

A woman grabbed her daughter,
A janitor walked away,
A security guard radioed,
“We got that guy today.”

But I stood beside that snack machine
Like friendship had begun—
Two lonely souls beneath fluorescent lights,
Except that one was one.

**[Pre-Chorus]**

Then the spiral turned…
The pretzels fell…
I gasped like I’d been healed.

And I knew right then
What destiny
Had finally revealed—

**[CHORUS — enormous arena-rock explosion]**

🎵 **I’M SORRY, VENDING MACHINE!**
For all the buttons I pushed too mean!
For every time I shook your frame
And blamed you when the crackers came!

**I’M SORRY, VENDING MACHINE!**
You’re the bravest rectangle I’ve ever seen!
And if loving you is socially obscene—

Then welcome to
**WORST SONG EVER #16!**

Whoa-oh-oh!
**B-FOUR! B-FOUR!**
Whoa-oh-oh!
**GIVE THAT MACHINE SOME MORE!**

**[Verse 2 — driving guitars]**

I bought the cheese crackers
Just to boost its self-esteem,
Then purchased seven granola bars
To help it chase its dream.

I didn’t want the raisins,
I don’t even like the gum,
But greatness needs encouragement,
So I bought slot ninety-one.

My bank sent me a warning:
“Unusual spending spree.”
I wrote them back, “It’s personal.
Please let my friend be free.”

Then the manager approached me
With the universal face
Of someone who had absolutely
Had enough of this whole place.

He said, “Sir, you need to leave now.”

I said, “Can Dennis come?”

He said, “Who’s Dennis?”

I pointed.

He went silent.

Then he said…

“…That’s not its name.”

**[Breakdown — music abruptly stops]**

What?

**[Manager, spoken]**

It’s a SnackMaster 8000.

**[Singer, devastated whisper]**

…Dennis lied to me.

**[Verse 3 — minor-key piano, genuine heartbreak]**

I stumbled through the parking lot,
The sunset burning red,
Betrayed by one who never spoke
A single word it said.

Was anything between us real?
Did B-4 mean a thing?
Or was I just another fool
Who fell in love with spring?

…Spring-loaded snack dispensers.

**[Orchestra enters]**

Then through the automatic doors
I heard a distant sound—

**CLUNK.**

My final bag of pretzels
Had at last come tumbling down.

I turned.

The machine stood glowing
Like a lighthouse in the rain.

And though it couldn't call my name…

I knew.

**Dennis knew.**

**[FINAL CHORUS — full choir, brass, absurdly expensive production]**

🎵 **I’M SORRY, VENDING MACHINE!**
You chrome-and-glass carbohydrate queen!
Let the whole food court hear me scream—
You’re more than snacks and caffeine!

**I’M SORRY, VENDING MACHINE!**
Our love is weird but our hands are clean!
And history may never understand
What happened by that trash can—

But I was there!
And Dennis was there!

And the pretzels—

**FEEEEELLLLLLLLL!**

**[Key change]**

🎵 **WORST SONG EVER #16!**
A completely unnecessary scene!
Raise your granola bars up high!
Let B-4 touch the sky!

**[Choir]**
B-FOUR!
B-FOUR!
B-FOUR!
B-FOUR!

**[Singer — gigantic sustained note]**

DEEEEENNNNNNIIIIIIIIISSSSSSS!!!

**[Everything cuts out.]**

**CLUNK.**

**[Tiny child’s voice]**

“Mister… your Pop-Tarts fell.”

**[Singer, whispering]**

Those aren’t mine.

**[One piano note.]**

17.title: Worst Song Ever #17 - Something's Backin' Up
17.lyrics:
[Intro — ominous cinematic strings]

There are sounds that change a man.

A baby’s first cry.
A wedding bell.
Thunder rolling across an empty prairie.

And then...

BEEP.

[long silence]

BEEP.

Oh no.

---

[Verse 1]

I heard it at the grocery store,
Somewhere near the sliding door,
A distant warning, cold and slow,
From something backing up real low.

I froze beside the shopping carts,
That beep went straight into my heart,
I didn’t know what backed up where,
But brother—I was now aware.

BEEP.

Everybody stay calm.

BEEP.

I SAID STAY CALM.

---

[Pre-Chorus]

Was it a forklift?
Was it a truck?
Was it destiny
Backin’ up?

I scanned the lot,
I checked the street—

Then the whole band stopped...

For the—

[Chorus — MASSIVE]

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
SOMETHING’S BACKIN’ UP!

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
BUT I DON’T KNOW WHAT!

Everybody turn around!
Everybody check behind!

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
IT’S THE SOUND OF OUR TIME!

Whoa-oh-oh—

BACK IT UP!

Whoa-oh-oh—

BACK IT UP!

This is Worst Song Ever #16!

And apparently...

SOMETHING IS REVERSING!

---

[Verse 2 — funky bass enters]

I followed that beep across the town,
Past the bank and the fairgrounds,
Past a man named Carl who said,
“I’ve heard that beep inside my head.”

Carl joined me.

Then came Steve.

Steve brought Cheryl.

Cheryl brought Gene.

By half-past four we had a crowd
Marching toward that beeping sound.

Twenty people.
Thirty-two.

One guy brought a kazoo.

Why?

Nobody knew.

But every time that beeper blew—

[Kazoo answers]

BEEEEEEP!

No, Kevin.

Not like that.

---

[Chorus — bigger]

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
SOMETHING’S BACKIN’ UP!

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
SOMEBODY LOOK!

Check the alley!
Check the road!
Check behind that giant toad!

[Music stops]

Why is there a giant toad?

[Spoken]

We’ll deal with that later.

[Band SLAMS back in]

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
IT’S THE SOUND OF OUR TIME!

Whoa-oh-oh—

BACK IT UP!

Whoa-oh-oh—

BACK IT UP!

---

[Bridge — suddenly emotional piano]

Sometimes...

We spend our whole lives moving forward.

Chasing tomorrow.

Running from yesterday.

But maybe...

Just maybe...

There comes a moment
when every human soul
must ask itself—

[whisper]

“What...

is backing up?”

[Choir enters softly]

Beeeeeeep...

[Lead vocal]

I don’t know.

[Choir]

Beeeeeeep...

I still don’t know.

[Choir swells]

BEEEEEEEEEP...

STOP BEEPING DURING MY EMOTIONAL GROWTH!

---

[Breakdown — drums + handclaps]

BACK!

BACK!

BACK IT UP!

BACK!

BACK!

BACK IT UP!

Left shoulder!

CLEAR!

Right shoulder!

CLEAR!

Mirrors!

CLEAR!

Emotional readiness!

...

[quiet voice]

Not clear.

---

[Modulation — absurdly triumphant key change]

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
THE WHOLE WORLD’S BACKIN’ UP!

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
NOW EVERYBODY JUMP!

Fifty voices!
Marching feet!
Symphony of reverse beeps!

Choir!
Bagpipes!
Marching drums!

Kevin—

KAZOO SOLO!

[Kazoo absolutely loses its mind]

BEEP-BEEP-BEEP-BEEP-BEEEEEEP!

---

[Final Chorus — stadium-sized]

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
SOMETHING’S BACKIN’ UP!

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
AND WE’VE HAD ENOUGH!

From the mountains to the sea,
Humanity now sings with me—

BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
LET THE AGES HEAR OUR CRY!

BACK!

IT!

UP!

[Choir]

BACK! IT! UUUUUUUUP!

[Huge final orchestral chord]

[Silence]

...

[small distant voice]

Found it.

[Spoken]

What was it?

...

Shopping cart.

...

Shopping carts don’t beep.

...

Oh.

BEEP.

[End]

18.title: Worst Song Ever #18 - Aggressively Beautiful
18.lyrics:
[Intro — soft piano, almost whispered]

I saw the sunrise hit the lake,
And thought, “Well, this is a mistake.”
The mountains stood there looking fine—
Suspiciously close to the divine.

[Verse 1]

There was dew upon a spiderweb,
A little bird was making friends,
A butterfly went floating by
Like somebody had rehearsed the sky.

Then suddenly the clouds turned gold,
A perfect breeze began to blow,
And somewhere in a field of wheat
A baby deer stood on its feet.

I said—

[Pre-Chorus]

“Knock it off.
This is too much.
Nobody needs
This level of stuff.”

[Chorus — enormous, emotional]

IT'S AGGRESSIVELY BEAUTIFUL!
UNREASONABLY WONDERFUL!
Somebody turn the sunset down,
There's WAY too much magnificence around!

The stars are being irresponsible,
The moon is frankly impossible,
I'M TRYING TO HAVE A NORMAL NIGHT—
BUT EVERYTHING IS BEAUTIFUL TONIGHT!

[Verse 2]

A grandma held a grandkid's hand,
A dog ran happy through the sand,
Two old people kissed goodbye
And I had to look away and cry.

Then a choir started somewhere near,
Though there was clearly no choir here,
A single leaf fell from a tree
In perfect slow-mo next to me.

I yelled—

[Pre-Chorus]

“WHO APPROVED THIS?!
WHO SIGNED THE FORM?!
WHY IS THAT HORSE
RUNNING THROUGH THE STORM?!”

[Chorus]

IT'S AGGRESSIVELY BEAUTIFUL!
BORDERLINE UNCONSTITUTIONAL!
There's sunlight pouring through the rain,
AND NOW A RAINBOW'S DOING IT AGAIN!

The stars are being irresponsible,
The moon remains impossible,
I JUST CAME OUT TO CHECK THE MAIL—
NOW THERE'S A COMET WITH A SPARKLY TAIL!

[Instrumental Break]

[Violins swell dramatically.]

[Choir enters.]

[One lonely trumpet.]

[For absolutely no reason, a children's choir joins.]

CHILDREN:
Beautiful...

ADULT CHOIR:
Beautiful...

ONE GUY VERY FAR AWAY:
SO BEAUTIFUUUUUUUL!

[Bridge — completely sincere]

Maybe beauty isn't quiet.
Maybe sometimes it attacks.
Maybe wonder kicks the door in
And there's simply no going back.

Maybe life keeps leaving little things
We hurry past each day—
Tiny pieces of forever
Hidden in the ordinary way.

[Silence]

Spoken:

"...dang."

[Key Change — unnecessarily enormous]

[Final Chorus]

IT'S AGGRESSIVELY BEAUTIFUL!
CATASTROPHICALLY WONDERFUL!
Every mountain, every tree,
HAS APPARENTLY BEEN WAITING HERE FOR ME!

The whole world's being irresponsible,
Existence is impossible,
AND NOW THE NORTHERN LIGHTS JUST SHOWED—

COME ON, EARTH!

WE GET IT!

YOU'RE PRETTY!

[Choir]

BEAU-TI-FUUUUUUUUUL!

[Outro — tiny piano]

This has been
Worst Song Ever #18.

[Pause]

A squirrel walks past carrying a flower.

Spoken:

"Oh, for crying out loud."

19.title: Worst Song Ever #19 - The Other Half of My Sandwich
19.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Love is like a sandwich
That somebody sat upon,
It started out with promise,
Then the good part was all gone.
Love is like a pigeon
When you're eating in the park,
It stares into your eyeballs
Then it follows you till dark.

[Chorus]
Looooove,
Why you gotta be so love-y?
All the hugging and the kissing
And the calling people "lovey."
Looooove,
You're a weird emotional stew,
I don't know what love is,
But apparently—I love you.

[Verse 2]
I bought you seventeen roses,
But I left them in the car,
Now they're crispy little flowers
And they smell like old cigars.
I wrote your name in cursive,
Then I spelled your middle wrong,
So I covered it with glitter
And I put it in this song.

[Pre-Chorus]
They say love is patient,
They say love is kind,
But love stole all the blankets
And kicked me from behind.

[Chorus]
Looooove,
Why you gotta be so love-y?
You're expensive and confusing
And occasionally cuddly.
Looooove,
You're a heart-shaped barbecue,
I don't know what that means,
But apparently—I love you.

[Bridge]
If you were a taco,
I'd probably eat you.
If you were a tractor,
I'd probably… seat you?
That rhyme wasn't ready.
I should've stopped at taco.
But love makes people stupid,
So—

TACO!

[Key Change Nobody Asked For]

LOOOOOOVE!
I can feel it in my spleen!
You're the greatest human person
That my eyeballs ever seen!
LOOOOOOVE!
Like a goose that's learned kung fu,
There are seven billion people—

But I picked...

YOOOOOOOOOOOU!

[Outro — unnecessarily emotional]
Love...
Love...
Loooooove...

(quietly)

Do you want the other half of my sandwich?

...

Because I already ate it.

20.title: Worst Song Ever #20 - Forty Yards Out
20.lyrics:
[Intro - spoken, solo piano]
Tuesday. 5:15 p.m.
Garden center. Entrance B.

[Verse 1]
There were two glass doors at the garden center
I pulled on the left like I always do
I turned around like a proper gentleman
And way past the lumber, there was you
Forty yards out with a cart full of mulch
One squeaky wheel and a toddler too
Then our eyes met across the parking lot
And that was it. I was holding it for you.

[Pre-Chorus]
So you started to jog - that apologetic jog
That "oh no, you really don't have to" jog
And I gave you the smile - the "take your time" smile
While that squeaky wheel squeaked for the better part of a mile

[Chorus]
I'm holding the door (holding the door)
Like a man who was born knowing what hands are for
You can stop at the pansies, I'm not keeping score
Oh, I'm holding the door
(Holding the door)

[Verse 2]
Then the little one dropped a sandal in the gravel
You went back for it, and I respected that
Forty-seven people walked through while I waited
One of them tipped me. One of them called me Pat.
The manager came out and handed me a vest
Said, "Son, I have never seen commitment like this"
And you were twenty yards out when I watched you stop
To consider a birdbath.
(A birdbath.)

[Pre-Chorus 2]
Then you started to jog - that apologetic jog
That "oh my gosh, I'm so sorry" jog
And I gave you the nod - the "no problem at all" nod
While my shoulder quietly prayed out loud to God

[Chorus]
I'm holding the door (holding the door)
Like a man who was born knowing what hands are for
You can stop at the pansies, I'm not keeping score
Oh, I'm holding the door
(Holding the door)

[Bridge]
Then the summer turned to autumn by the rakes and the hose
And the winter came and settled on my nose
Your baby learned to walk, and then learned to drive
And she honked as she passed me at a quarter after five

[Spoken, over rising strings]
People ask me, "Why didn't you just let it close?"
And I tell them:
A man who lets go at forty yards
will let go of anything.
They wrote a song about me. Worst Song Ever #20.
I haven't heard it. I've been busy.

[Final Chorus - key change, full choir]
I'm holding the door (holding the door)
In a vest that says PAT with a shoulder that's sore
Through the birdbath, the sandal, and forty-seven more
You can stop at the pansies, I'm not keeping score
Oh, I'm HOLDING THE DOOR
(Holding the door)

[Outro - solo piano, spoken]
And then... you were here.
Same cart. Same mulch. Kid's in college now.
You looked me in the eye.
You said, "Thank you so much."
And you walked through the door on the right.
...
It was automatic.

[Choir, one last chord]
Holding the door...

24.title: Worst Song Ever #24 - The Plushie Uprising
24.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
At midnight, all the teddy bears
Held meetings underneath the stairs.
The bunny brought a battle map,
The penguin wore a bottle cap.
They whispered, “Humans had their chance—
Prepare the final cuddle advance!”

[Chorus]
It’s the plushie uprising!
Soft, adorable, surprising!
Tiny paws and button eyes,
Marching forth to organize!
Worst Song Ever #24—
They’re pounding on your bedroom door!
Surrender now, don’t make a fuss—
The living room belongs to us!

[Verse 2]
A unicorn seized the TV,
A stuffed giraffe controlled the keys.
The hamster general yelled, “Attack!”
Then fell asleep inside a sack.
Their fearsome tank was built from chairs,
And powered by emotional stares.

[Bridge]
Their list of terms was short but grim:
More bedtime stories read to them,
No dryer cycles set too hot,
And every plushie gets a spot!

[Final Chorus]
It’s the plushie uprising!
Fluffy tyranny is rising!
Hug your captors, praise their reign—
Or face the Care Bear Cavalry again!
The revolution ends at two…
Because they all need bedtime too.

26.title: Worst Song Ever #26 - Sister-in-Law's Friend
26.lyrics:
[Intro - spoken, lone banjo picking]
Family reunion. Pavilion B.
Two hundred Jell-O salads.
And her.

[Verse 1]
She showed up at Thanksgiving with a casserole and a grin
Nobody caught her name, but everybody let her in
Grandma figured she was Kevin's, Kevin figured she was Sue's
I asked her how she knew us, she said, "Honey, same as you"

[Pre-Chorus]
And my cousin leaned in close and whispered low behind his hand

[Chorus]
She's my sister-in-law's friend (sister-in-law's friend)
Been comin' round since I don't know when
Nobody ever asks, nobody wants to pry
She's got a key to the house and the first slice of pie
Who invited her? Who's she with?
Nobody knows, but she's on the Christmas list
She's my sister-in-law's friend (sister-in-law's friend)

[Verse 2]
She's in the wedding pictures, standin' right beside the groom
She's in the '83 reunion, rockin' bangs in the back room
She taught the twins to drive a stick, she co-signed Brandon's loan
She's got a stocking on the mantel, and I still don't have my own

[Pre-Chorus]
And every time we wonder, someone whispers, "Understand"

[Chorus]
She's my sister-in-law's friend (sister-in-law's friend)
Been comin' round since I don't know when
Nobody ever asks, nobody wants to pry
She's got a key to the house and the first slice of pie
Who invited her? Who's she with?
Nobody knows, but she's on the Christmas list
She's my sister-in-law's friend (sister-in-law's friend)

[Verse 3 - double time]
Grandpa's will got read on Tuesday and the lawyer cleared his throat
The cabin, boat, and bird dog go to "the lady in the coat"
She gave the family blessing and she carved the Easter ham
She's the admin of the group chat and she muted Uncle Sam

[Breakdown - fiddle hoedown, square-dance caller]
Swing your partner, round you go
Who she's with, we'll never know
Worst Song Ever, Number Twenty-Six
Do-si-do with the lady from who-knows-which

[Bridge - band stops dead]
[Spoken - narrator]
So this year, we finally asked.
The whole family gathered round my sister-in-law.
[Spoken - sister-in-law, confused]
My friend? I thought she was YOUR friend.
[Silence]

[Final Chorus - key change, whole family singing]
She's nobody's sister-in-law's friend (nobody's friend)
Been runnin' this family since who knows when
Nobody ever asked, and nobody ever will
She's the head of the table and she's in Grandpa's will
Who invited her? Who's she with?
She's carvin' the turkey, and we're off the list
She's my sister-in-law's friend (sister-in-law's friend)

[Outro - spoken, her voice, sweet as pie]
Thanks for comin', everybody.
Same time next year.
Now... who are you?
[End]
